subject: D FEM muxed onto pack UI CANDIDATE not FEM_PERSIST_PASS
body:
D-INTEG-01 FEM onto same native UI as pack. CANDIDATE. PROGRAM=NO.
NOT FEM_PERSIST_PASS / MIG_PASS / BOARD_PASS / TIMING_PASS.

FACT: fem_on_mig + fem_req_ui + mig_ui_mux. Pack (A) vs FEM (B) exclusive grant; pack wins.
FEM_BASE=28'h0200000 (bit 21, not slot 0/1). Completion = dest readback + txn/gen echo. FIFO-empty is not complete.

XSim xsim v2026.1:
  FEM_MIG_UI32_XSIM_PASS @ 7195 ns (compaction OK, PROXY_METRIC_FALSE_PASS_GUARD, recover_state=2)
  PACK_MIG_UI32_XSIM_PASS 5/5 after mig_ui_bram 12-bit fold {addr[21:20], addr[13:4]}

arty_a7_r2_top: mux onto mig_ui_bram (mig0 still unbound in this top).
arty_a7_mig_top: mux onto generated mig0 on ui_clk. FEM moved off CLK100MHZ local dest.
Q*/SPEAR still CLK100MHZ. C ports unchanged.
